summary: @servicetitan/quick-actions preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload
details: The package declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that downloads the Bun runtime from GitHub releases, chmods it executable, and uses that alternate runtime to run a sibling file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a ~727 KB single-line, string-array-shuffle obfuscated blob (rotating array `n7gIxM`, shift function `WV8StW`, custom decoder `hc1jfK9`, hex-named identifiers) whose behavior is intentionally opaque to Node-based static analysis and is only reachable via the Bun-invoked path. The advertised functionality is a small React quick-actions component library, which does not require Bun or any install-time native binary; the preinstall dropper is unrelated to the stated purpose. On `npm install`, this executes attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine under an alternate runtime that Node-focused scanners do not inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
